creatorPrompt: Build a sky-harbor 'Skyglider Skip-Count Run' where a small glider character sits fixed in the center-left of the screen. Ahead of it, present a horizontal row of exactly 3 stationary lantern-platform buttons (data-testid='answer-option') showing candidate numbers continuing a skip-count sequence (by 2s, 5s, or 10s per question). Only one platform per question is correct. The glider and platforms must NOT move location when tapped except the glider's forward hop animation triggered by a correct tap; background clouds/islands should drift to imply motion instead. Include a toggleable 'Show me' demo (data-testid='show-me-toggle') that plays a short replayable animation of the glider hopping on an EXAMPLE sequence only (never the actual question's answer) and a 'Let me try' control (data-testid='let-me-try-toggle') that hands control back to the child. Include a visible sound toggle (data-testid='sound-toggle') and initialize all audio only after the first child gesture. On wrong tap: platform dims/shakes in place, plays a soft recovery chime, no penalty, same options remain. On correct tap: glider hops forward with whoosh sound, lantern bridge segment lights up (progress bar made of lantern icons), question count is exactly 3 matching the questions array. On completing all 3, play a completion fanfare, glider does a loop animation, and show a 'Skip-Count Pilot' badge. Keep this as teaching/practice evidence only -- do not display any mastery or unlock language. The activity title 'Skyglider Skip-Count Run' must be visible in the opening viewport alongside the loaded background artwork.
